                         Project Development Objectives
                         Project Development Objective (from Project Appraisal Document)

                         The Project Development Objectives are to preserve key lifeline infrastructure and reduce household vulnerability in targeted areas.

                         Has the Project Development Objective been changed since Board Approval of the Project?

                            Yes           No

                         Overall Risk Rating                      High                                  High

                         Implementation Status Overview
                         Despite some minor slippages, key project activities are being implemented according to the agreed schedule. More specifically: (i) the emergency road infrastructure works are
                         expected to start on the ground by mid-2014; (ii) the social protection (rehabilitation of community infrastructure and cash-for-work program) activities started activities on the ground;
                         (iii) the implementation of the Disaster Risk Management (DRM) related activities has commenced; and (iv) the first batch of small scale irrigation schemes are scheduled to start
                         during the month of October 2013 and to be completed by the start of the next rainy season.



                                                                                                                                                                                                          Page 1 of 6
                             The World Bank                                                                                                                                         Report No: ISR11489



                         Furthermore, most of the agreed actions since the April 2013 implementation support mission have been completed. More specifically: (i) the staff members of the Project
                         Coordination Unit (PCU) are now recruited; (b) all the implementing agencies could create their respective Designated Accounts, complete the processes to access to “Client
                         Connection?, and proceed to withdraw funds.
Public Disclosure Copy




                         Thanks to the good initial implementation of the project, and less than six months after effectiveness, the project’s disbursement rate is now 11% (or 17%, including the initial
                         advances). As a result, the project’s implementation progress is rated Satisfactory.
